CustomField.description: API name of the Prompt Builder Flex template the AI provider invokes. Leave blank to use the default name DocGen_HTML_Body. You create the template yourself in Setup > Einstein > Prompt Builder: a packaged prompt template makes the whole package require the Generative AI Prompt Templates feature, which would block install for every org without Einstein. Portwood does not read this field itself; it is here so your provider class can be pointed at a differently named template without editing Apex. See UserGuide section 5.7.11.
CustomField.label: AI Prompt Template
